items.title: CWAB honours Bangladesh Test team after Australia success
items.summary: The Cricketers Welfare Association of Bangladesh (CWAB) on Thursday hosted a luncheon and reception in honour of the Bangladesh Test team following their historic success in Australia last month.

items.title: BCB charges Chattogram Royals owner, Durbar Rajshahi official over BPL corruption allegations
items.summary: The Bangladesh Cricket Board (BCB) has charged two more individuals with multiple breaches of the ICC Anti-Corruption Code in connection with alleged corruption during the Bangladesh Premier League (BPL), the board said in a press release on Thursday.
